design.decision: Win with low cards (ruff with a low [♠] instead of a high one, and keep length for late tricks) and bid higher, since every low win is worth more with a bigger contract and all of it is lost on a set.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first low win; opponents overruff low trumps and lead honors to drain the team's low cards.
design.rationale: Low Cards has no payoff that scales with contract size; this adds bid tension, since contract points vanish on a set. Rare pays +50 or more per event at a typical contract. [2]-[9] matches uc-low-win-mult, so the two stack.
design.draftText: +10 contract points for each trick in your team's contract when your team wins a trick with a [2] through [9]

critic.concerns: Long sentence with two numbers, a range, and contract scaling; the per-contract-trick points pattern is now in many sigils.
